windy.configuration.title: %s
windy.config.general.tooltip: How much wind there is and how far it reaches.
windy.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for the living wind.
windy.config.intensity.tooltip: How much of the wind you see per tick.
windy.config.radius.tooltip: How far around you the wind is drawn.
windy.config.gustiness.tooltip: How often the wind gathers into a gust. 0 keeps the world calm.
windy.config.effects.tooltip: Turn individual wind effects on and off.
windy.config.stripes.tooltip: Long flowing ribbons of air that snake downwind and follow the land over hills.
windy.config.motes.tooltip: Tiny specks tumbling in the current, everywhere the wind reaches.
windy.config.wisps.tooltip: Pale streaks that ride the wind while a gust is up.
windy.config.leaves.tooltip: Leaves pulled from tree canopies, tinted to each biome's own foliage.
windy.config.snow.tooltip: Snow whipped near-horizontal while it snows in cold biomes.
windy.config.dust.tooltip: Dry motes lifted off sand in hot, rainless biomes.
windy.config.ambient.tooltip: Motes that hang in the air of each biome.
windy.config.ambient_enabled.tooltip: Master switch for the ambient biome motes.
windy.config.ambient_density.tooltip: How much living air to emit. Higher densities still defer to your vanilla particle setting and fade indoors.
windy.config.ambient_radius.tooltip: Radius of the sphere around you that motes appear in.
windy.config.fireflies.tooltip: Warm motes over swamps and forests after dark.
windy.config.pollen.tooltip: Spores drifting through jungles, flower forests and lush caves by day.
windy.config.heat_dust.tooltip: Fine ash skidding across deserts, badlands and savannas.
windy.config.embers.tooltip: Embers, flame flecks and smoke near lava and in the volcanic Nether.
windy.config.snow_sparkle.tooltip: Sparkling snow motes on frozen peaks and snowy biomes.
windy.config.cherry_petals.tooltip: Blossom petals swirling through cherry groves.
windy.config.day_night.tooltip: Fireflies come out at dusk; spores and dust show by day.
windy.config.weather_aware.tooltip: Fade outdoor motes out during rain and thunder.
windy.config.enclosure.tooltip: Damp outdoor motes when you can't see the sky (indoors / deep underground).
windy.config.compat.tooltip: How Windy behaves alongside vanilla settings.
windy.config.vanilla_particles.tooltip: Ease off when the vanilla particle setting is Decreased, and stop on Minimal.
windy.config.aeronautics.tooltip: Follow the local wind from Aeronautics: Winds & Weather.
windy.config.wind_source.tooltip: AUTO follows Aeronautics when installed; VANILLA keeps Windy's own living wind; AERONAUTICS prefers it and warns if unavailable.
windy.config.aeronautics_full_strength.t: Aeronautics wind speed that maps to Windy's nominal full visual strength. Aeronautics' base wind is 6 m/s and its cap is 55 m/s.
windy.config.aeronautics_weather.tooltip: Use Aeronautics' regional weather for snow, dust, rain fading and storm visuals.
windy.config.grassier_grass_sync.tooltip: Drive Grassier Grass's wind direction and strength from Windy while an external wind source (Aeronautics) is active. Does nothing if Grassier Grass is absent.
